claimChanges.claimText: 武汉大学AI通识课程平台 is listed for Wuhan University in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

Wuhan University Library's national AI MOOC page curates AI-related MOOCs from Xuexi Qiangguo, the National Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Platform, and the National Higher Education Smart Education Platform, and it lists a Wuhan University course titled '人工智能' taught by Xie Rong on the National Higher Education Smart Education Platform.

Wuhan University Library's AI usage guides and norms page curates AI-use guidance from domestic and foreign university libraries; examples listed include Tsinghua University Library's AIGC topic guide, ShanghaiTech University's generative AI usage guide, Shenzhen University Library's AI-use guide, and CUHK Library's guidelines and best practices for using AI tools.

Wuhan University Library maintains an AI resource navigation page that groups AI-related teaching and research reference resources into sections such as AI MOOCs, AI usage guides and norms, AI policies, AI laws, declarations, literacy frameworks, conferences, and organizations; the page says the navigation is for teaching and research reference and asks readers to judge accuracy themselves.
